extracted.name: Smashed cannellini bean tartine
extracted.description: A mix of garlic, chilli, parsley and smashed cannellini beans top these no-cook tartines along with feta and tomatoes. They're quick and easy, and healthy, too
ingredient_lines: 400g can cannellini beans drained and rinsed
1 small red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Put the beans, 1 tbsp of the oil, the lemon zest and juice and the garlic in a food processor and blitz to create a chunky texture. Transfer to a bowl and stir through the chilli, parsley and cherry tomatoes.
Lightly toast the bread and pile on the cannellini bean smash, scatter over the feta and drizzle with the remaining oil. Serve with the rocket on the side.
